purpose: Local, throwaway proposed mocks for clipp-relay; all identities, hosts and usage are synthetic.

variants.A: Workspace: framed sheet and labelled navigation. Recommended for regular account and administration work.
variants.B: Open ledger: top navigation and one open plane; review opens a detail page. Simpler for occasional visits.
variants.C: Connection desk: persistent allowance summary beside history; account review uses a compact queue.

kept: Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript, compatible with the existing Go template stack
direction.alternates: B and C are structural comparisons for the prototype question, not production theme settings.

idea: The relay account’s separate allowance, live Relay Sessions and Login Grants become one access-and-capacity summary. No device membership or per-device data is invented.

screen_questions.account: Can I use the relay, and what allowance and capacity remain?
screen_questions.admin: Which accounts need review, and what would approval assign?
screen_questions.plans: Which quota plans can be assigned, and what are their limits?
screen_questions.access: Which kind of sign-in or authorization will this control end?
screen_questions.consent: Which app is requesting permission for which relay account?
screen_questions.pending: What blocks relay use, and what can I prepare?
screen_questions.sign-in: How do I sign in, and does approval apply?
screen_questions.error: Why did the update fail, and how do I recover?

style_changes: Flat #f1f4f2 frame, white sheet, #192d27 ink, #596760 secondary ink, #23654c data accent.
24px titles; 32px lead figure; 14px working text; 12–13px supporting and axis text.
8px inset panels and 6px controls; 16px outer workspace sheet. No resting shadows.
Sentence-case labels, a 24px shared gap, right-aligned tabular figures.
44px phone controls; menu folds; account rows retain a visible Review action.
One green current-week series; neutral completed weeks; no decorative gradients or large KPI tiles.

validation.offline: Self-contained HTML verified directly via file://; four chart bars rendered, styles loaded, no browser exceptions.
validation.visual_review: All 78 emitted fold/page-sheet screenshots viewed through thirteen labelled contact sheets.
validation.lint: 0 FAIL; 2 shadow warnings, restricted to the floating toast and dialog.

remaining_warnings.hero-void: Narrow sign-in/consent/error tasks and a two-plan list intentionally keep their honest content size. No imagery or invented rows were added to fill the desktop.
remaining_warnings.panel-void: The full workspace sheet is a canvas, not a data card. Consent has a 43px internal brand-to-title spacing band.
remaining_warnings.tiny-text: Remaining flags concern supporting metadata, axis ticks or the design comparison table; primary account data and actions remain 14px or larger. These are still worth reviewing on a physical phone.

rounds:
ROUND 1
Seen in one second: Remaining relay allowance, then the current-week history.
Idea (one sentence): Allowance, Relay Sessions and Login Grants form one account summary.
Live thing: Range selection, discovery URL copying and a working approval queue.
Layout words by section: shell=framed workspace / allowance=divided strip / history=chart / setup=compact panel / security=row
Scores: design 7.2 · usability 7.4 · creativity 7 · content 8 → overall 7.3
Caps applied: App-screen rules; no image or motion floor.
Top three problems (most visible first), each with the screenshot it shows in and the fix:
1. A-account/mobile-fold.jpg: too many 12px working labels. Increased metric labels and explanatory text.
2. C-account/tablet-fold.jpg: inline snapshot text runs into its usage-details action. Stacked those items.
3. A-account/mobile-fold.jpg: discovery copying is below history. Added Connect Clipp to the title row.

ROUND 2
Seen in one second: Allowance first, approval actions next to their assigned limits.
Idea (one sentence): The same three account measures remain distinct across every layout.
Live thing: Sample account filtering, approval and quota-plan creation.
Layout words by section: shell=framed workspace / review=master-detail / plans=table / consent=single task
Scores: design 7.5 · usability 7.8 · creativity 7 · content 8.2 → overall 7.6
Caps applied: App-screen rules.
Top three problems (most visible first), each with the screenshot it shows in and the fix:
1. A-admin/desktop-fold.jpg: default one-item pending queue creates a large unused list area. Defaulted to all five honest sample accounts, keeping the pending account first and its filter one click away.
2. A-consent/desktop-fold.jpg: a wide sheet stretches a narrow authorization task. Replaced it with a compact message surface.
3. A-plans/desktop-fold.jpg: supporting table and status text remains too small. Raised tables, badges and key meta to 13px.

ROUND 3
Seen in one second: 768 MiB remaining; a specific app can be connected from the header.
Idea (one sentence): Separate relay entitlements become one honest, readable access-and-capacity surface.
Live thing: URL copying, history range, approval filter, sample forms and three layout options.
Layout words by section: account=divided summary / history=chart+connection panel / administration=queue+decision / plans=table / security=label+controls / authorization=compact task
Scores: design 7.8 · usability 8 · creativity 7 · content 8.5 → overall 7.8
Caps applied: Competitor-test ceiling of 7 on creativity; app-screen exceptions for rules, form borders and narrow task surfaces. No image or motion floor.
Top three problems (most visible first), each with the screenshot it shows in and the fix:
1. A-account/mobile-fold.jpg: email and date wrap densely beside the header action. A production refinement should put the week under the allowance instead.
2. A-plans/desktop-fold.jpg: two actual plans leave unused workspace. Keep the content honest; revisit compact canvas height if the product stays this small.
3. C-account/tablet-fold.jpg: its persistent left summary gives a tall column at tablet size. Prefer A for broad device coverage; C is best on desktop.

sample_content.history: 13 weekly synthetic totals; current week agrees with account summary

assets: No stock photos, generated artwork, web fonts, external dependencies or runtime data. The brand mark and icons are code drawings; usage charts are SVG from the skill helper, not photographs.
integration_notes: Live authentication, authorization, quota changes and account deletion are not connected. All mutation-looking controls use local sample data or explicit preview dialogs.
The proposed consent account identity and Cancel action need handler data and the validated OAuth cancellation path.
Server-side email/status filtering must query the full dataset, not just a fetched page.
Named plan display needs a reliable lookup when the plan is outside the current page. Preserve saved assignment snapshots.
Keep recovery holds, revision checks, CSRF, operation identity, reason codes and one-session-per-Peer-ID admission intact.
Choose a layout before rewriting the winning design in the actual Go templates. This artifact is not a production implementation.
status: Ready for design feedback. No production source changed or committed.
